policy.rule: Use a diagnostic code only when the authored wrong path deterministically supports it; otherwise return unmapped.
policy.ai_boundary: AI may explain only an established deterministic result using approved source cards. It may not establish correctness, invent a diagnosis, or complete a protected active assessment.

feedback.en: The binomial coefficient was chosen incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Биномиальный коэффициент выбран неверно.
feedback.uz: Binomial koeffitsiyent noto‘g‘ri tanlangan.

next_action.en: For the (r+1)th term use nCr, with r starting from 0.
next_action.ru: Для (r+1)-го члена используйте nCr, где r начинается с 0.
next_action.uz: (r+1)-had uchun nCr dan foydalaning, bunda r 0 dan boshlanadi.

feedback.en: The powers of the two binomial terms were advanced incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Степени двух частей бинома изменены неверно.
feedback.uz: Binomning ikki qismidagi darajalar noto‘g‘ri o‘zgartirilgan.

next_action.en: In term r+1, powers are n−r and r; their sum stays n.
next_action.ru: В члене r+1 степени равны n−r и r; их сумма остаётся n.
next_action.uz: r+1-hadda darajalar n−r va r bo‘ladi; yig‘indisi n bo‘lib qoladi.

feedback.en: The sign from a negative binomial term was handled incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Знак отрицательного члена бинома обработан неверно.
feedback.uz: Binomdagi manfiy had ishorasi noto‘g‘ri hisoblangan.

next_action.en: Keep the negative sign inside the powered term: (−bx)^r changes sign with the parity of r.
next_action.ru: Сохраняйте минус внутри степени: (−bx)^r меняет знак в зависимости от чётности r.
next_action.uz: Minusni daraja ichida saqlang: (−bx)^r ishorasi r juft/toqligiga bog‘liq.

feedback.en: A numerical multiplier such as 2 or 3 was not raised to the required power.
feedback.ru: Числовой множитель, например 2 или 3, не возведён в нужную степень.
feedback.uz: 2 yoki 3 kabi sonli ko‘paytuvchi kerakli darajaga ko‘tarilmagan.

next_action.en: Apply the exponent to the whole term, e.g. (2x)^r=2^r x^r.
next_action.ru: Возводите в степень весь член, например (2x)^r=2^r x^r.
next_action.uz: Darajani butun hadga qo‘llang, masalan (2x)^r=2^r x^r.

feedback.en: The requested term number was confused with the binomial index r.
feedback.ru: Номер требуемого члена перепутан с биномиальным индексом r.
feedback.uz: So‘ralgan had raqami binomial indeks r bilan adashtirilgan.

next_action.en: The 1st term has r=0, the 2nd has r=1, so the kth term uses r=k−1.
next_action.ru: 1-й член соответствует r=0, 2-й — r=1, поэтому k-й член использует r=k−1.
next_action.uz: 1-had r=0, 2-had r=1; demak k-had uchun r=k−1.

feedback.en: The power of x was not set to zero when looking for a constant term.
feedback.ru: При поиске свободного члена степень x не приравнена к нулю.
feedback.uz: O‘zgarmas hadni topishda x darajasi 0 ga tenglashtirilmagan.

next_action.en: Write the general term and set the total exponent of x equal to 0.
next_action.ru: Запишите общий член и приравняйте суммарную степень x к 0.
next_action.uz: Umumiy hadni yozib, x ning umumiy darajasini 0 ga tenglang.

feedback.en: The coefficient equation for the unknown parameter was set up or solved incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Уравнение для неизвестного параметра по коэффициенту составлено или решено неверно.
feedback.uz: Noma’lum parametr uchun koeffitsiyent tenglamasi noto‘g‘ri tuzilgan yoki yechilgan.

next_action.en: Form the exact target coefficient first, then solve the resulting algebraic equation and apply any sign restriction.
next_action.ru: Сначала составьте точный требуемый коэффициент, затем решите алгебраическое уравнение и примените ограничения на знак.
next_action.uz: Avval kerakli aniq koeffitsiyentni tuzing, keyin algebraik tenglamani yeching va ishora cheklovini qo‘llang.

feedback.en: A sequence was classified as arithmetic without a constant difference.
feedback.ru: Последовательность признана арифметической без постоянной разности.
feedback.uz: Ketma-ketlik doimiy ayirmasiz arifmetik deb tasniflangan.

next_action.en: Check consecutive differences; an AP has the same difference throughout.
next_action.ru: Проверьте соседние разности; у AP разность постоянна.
next_action.uz: Ketma-ket ayirmalarni tekshiring; AP da ayirma doimiy.

feedback.en: A sequence was classified as geometric without a constant ratio.
feedback.ru: Последовательность признана геометрической без постоянного отношения.
feedback.uz: Ketma-ketlik doimiy nisbat bo‘lmasdan geometrik deb tasniflangan.

next_action.en: Check consecutive ratios; a GP has the same non-zero ratio throughout.
next_action.ru: Проверьте отношения соседних членов; у GP отношение постоянно.
next_action.uz: Ketma-ket nisbatlarni tekshiring; GP da nol bo‘lmagan nisbat doimiy.

feedback.en: Difference and ratio tests were confused.
feedback.ru: Перепутаны проверки по разности и отношению.
feedback.uz: Ayirma va nisbat tekshiruvlari adashtirilgan.

next_action.en: Use subtraction for AP recognition and division for GP recognition.
next_action.ru: Для AP используйте вычитание, для GP — деление.
next_action.uz: AP ni aniqlashda ayirish, GP da bo‘lishdan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The sequence was forced into AP or GP even though neither pattern is constant.
feedback.ru: Последовательность ошибочно отнесена к AP или GP, хотя ни один шаблон не постоянен.
feedback.uz: Ayirma ham, nisbat ham doimiy bo‘lmasa ham ketma-ketlik AP yoki GP deb majburan tasniflangan.

next_action.en: If neither consecutive differences nor ratios stay constant, classify it as neither.
next_action.ru: Если ни разности, ни отношения не постоянны, это ни AP, ни GP.
next_action.uz: Agar ketma-ket ayirmalar ham, nisbatlar ham doimiy bo‘lmasa, u neither.

feedback.en: The arithmetic nth-term formula used n instead of n−1.
feedback.ru: В формуле n-го члена AP использовано n вместо n−1.
feedback.uz: AP ning n-had formulasida n−1 o‘rniga n ishlatilgan.

next_action.en: Use u_n=a+(n−1)d.
next_action.ru: Используйте u_n=a+(n−1)d.
next_action.uz: u_n=a+(n−1)d dan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The arithmetic-series sum formula was applied incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Формула суммы арифметической прогрессии применена неверно.
feedback.uz: Arifmetik progressiya yig‘indisi formulasi noto‘g‘ri qo‘llangan.

next_action.en: Use S_n=n/2[2a+(n−1)d] or n(a+l)/2.
next_action.ru: Используйте S_n=n/2[2a+(n−1)d] или n(a+l)/2.
next_action.uz: S_n=n/2[2a+(n−1)d] yoki n(a+l)/2 dan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The inverse arithmetic-progression conditions were not combined correctly.
feedback.ru: Обратные условия арифметической прогрессии объединены неверно.
feedback.uz: Arifmetik progressiyaning teskari shartlari noto‘g‘ri birlashtirilgan.

next_action.en: Translate each given term/sum into an equation in a and d, then solve the equations together.
next_action.ru: Переведите каждый заданный член/сумму в уравнение относительно a и d и решите систему.
next_action.uz: Har bir berilgan had/yig‘indini a va d bo‘yicha tenglamaga aylantirib, birgalikda yeching.

feedback.en: The requested term number was solved from the nth-term equation incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Номер требуемого члена неверно найден из формулы n-го члена.
feedback.uz: So‘ralgan had raqami n-had tenglamasidan noto‘g‘ri topilgan.

next_action.en: Set a+(n−1)d equal to the target term and solve for integer n.
next_action.ru: Приравняйте a+(n−1)d к требуемому члену и найдите целое n.
next_action.uz: a+(n−1)d ni kerakli hadga tenglab, butun n ni toping.

feedback.en: The condition for three numbers to be consecutive arithmetic terms was used incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Условие трёх последовательных членов AP использовано неверно.
feedback.uz: Uchta ketma-ket AP hadi sharti noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

next_action.en: For consecutive AP terms p,q,r, use 2q=p+r.
next_action.ru: Для последовательных членов AP p,q,r используйте 2q=p+r.
next_action.uz: Ketma-ket AP hadlari p,q,r uchun 2q=p+r.

feedback.en: The geometric nth-term formula used r^n instead of r^(n−1).
feedback.ru: В формуле n-го члена GP использовано r^n вместо r^(n−1).
feedback.uz: GP ning n-had formulasida r^n o‘rniga r^(n−1) ishlatilgan.

next_action.en: Use u_n=ar^(n−1).
next_action.ru: Используйте u_n=ar^(n−1).
next_action.uz: u_n=ar^(n−1) dan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The finite geometric-sum formula was applied incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Формула конечной суммы GP применена неверно.
feedback.uz: GP ning chekli yig‘indi formulasi noto‘g‘ri qo‘llangan.

next_action.en: Use S_n=a(1−r^n)/(1−r), or an equivalent form, for r≠1.
next_action.ru: Используйте S_n=a(1−r^n)/(1−r) или эквивалентную форму при r≠1.
next_action.uz: r≠1 bo‘lsa S_n=a(1−r^n)/(1−r) yoki teng kuchli ko‘rinishdan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The common ratio was found in the wrong direction or with the wrong sign.
feedback.ru: Общее отношение найдено в неверном направлении или с неверным знаком.
feedback.uz: Umumiy nisbat noto‘g‘ri yo‘nalishda yoki ishora bilan topilgan.

next_action.en: Use r=u_{n+1}/u_n and keep the sign.
next_action.ru: Используйте r=u_{n+1}/u_n и сохраняйте знак.
next_action.uz: r=u_{n+1}/u_n dan foydalanib, ishorani saqlang.

feedback.en: The inverse geometric-progression conditions were not combined correctly.
feedback.ru: Обратные условия геометрической прогрессии объединены неверно.
feedback.uz: Geometrik progressiyaning teskari shartlari noto‘g‘ri birlashtirilgan.

next_action.en: Write each given term/sum in a and r, then solve the resulting equations and apply sign restrictions.
next_action.ru: Запишите каждый заданный член/сумму через a и r, решите систему и примените ограничения на знак.
next_action.uz: Har bir berilgan had/yig‘indini a va r orqali yozib, tenglamalarni yeching va ishora cheklovlarini qo‘llang.

feedback.en: The condition for three consecutive geometric terms was used incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Условие трёх последовательных членов GP использовано неверно.
feedback.uz: Uchta ketma-ket GP hadi sharti noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

next_action.en: For consecutive non-zero GP terms p,q,r, use q²=pr.
next_action.ru: Для последовательных ненулевых членов GP p,q,r используйте q²=pr.
next_action.uz: Ketma-ket nol bo‘lmagan GP hadlari p,q,r uchun q²=pr.

feedback.en: An alternating geometric progression lost the negative sign of its ratio.
feedback.ru: В чередующейся GP потерян отрицательный знак отношения.
feedback.uz: Almashinuvchi GP da nisbatning manfiy ishorasi yo‘qotilgan.

next_action.en: If signs alternate, the common ratio is negative; carry that sign through powers and sums.
next_action.ru: Если знаки чередуются, отношение отрицательно; сохраняйте знак в степенях и суммах.
next_action.uz: Ishoralar almashsa, umumiy nisbat manfiy; daraja va yig‘indilarda shu ishorani saqlang.

feedback.en: The convergence condition for an infinite geometric series was applied incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Условие сходимости бесконечной GP применено неверно.
feedback.uz: Cheksiz GP yig‘indisining yaqinlashish sharti noto‘g‘ri qo‘llangan.

next_action.en: A geometric series has a finite sum to infinity exactly when |r|<1.
next_action.ru: Геометрический ряд имеет конечную сумму до бесконечности тогда и только тогда, когда |r|<1.
next_action.uz: Geometrik qatorning cheksiz yig‘indisi faqat |r|<1 bo‘lganda mavjud.

feedback.en: The sum-to-infinity formula was applied incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Формула суммы до бесконечности применена неверно.
feedback.uz: Cheksiz yig‘indi formulasi noto‘g‘ri qo‘llangan.

next_action.en: For |r|<1, use S∞=a/(1−r).
next_action.ru: При |r|<1 используйте S∞=a/(1−r).
next_action.uz: |r|<1 bo‘lsa S∞=a/(1−r) dan foydalaning.

feedback.en: The sign in 1−r was handled incorrectly, especially for negative r.
feedback.ru: Знак в 1−r обработан неверно, особенно при отрицательном r.
feedback.uz: 1−r dagi ishora, ayniqsa r manfiy bo‘lsa, noto‘g‘ri hisoblangan.

next_action.en: Substitute the signed value of r into 1−r before simplifying.
next_action.ru: Подставьте r вместе со знаком в 1−r до упрощения.
next_action.uz: Soddalashtirishdan oldin r ni ishorasi bilan 1−r ga qo‘ying.

feedback.en: The first term, ratio and infinite sum relation were rearranged incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Связь между первым членом, отношением и суммой до бесконечности преобразована неверно.
feedback.uz: Birinchi had, nisbat va cheksiz yig‘indi orasidagi bog‘lanish noto‘g‘ri qayta tuzilgan.

next_action.en: Start from S∞=a/(1−r), solve algebraically, then verify |r|<1.
next_action.ru: Начните с S∞=a/(1−r), решите алгебраически и затем проверьте |r|<1.
next_action.uz: S∞=a/(1−r) dan boshlab algebraik yeching, keyin |r|<1 ni tekshiring.

feedback.en: The parameter range for convergence was solved incorrectly.
feedback.ru: Диапазон параметра для сходимости найден неверно.
feedback.uz: Yaqinlashish uchun parametr oralig‘i noto‘g‘ri topilgan.

next_action.en: Write |r(parameter)|<1 and solve the resulting double inequality carefully.
next_action.ru: Запишите |r(параметр)|<1 и аккуратно решите двойное неравенство.
next_action.uz: |r(parametr)|<1 ni yozib, hosil bo‘lgan qo‘sh tengsizlikni ehtiyotkorlik bilan yeching.
